prerequisites: Having passed 110 credits in the ordinary call of the first semester.
Not having already passed the elective course 'External Internships'.
Having at least the same number of elective credits pending as the course has, i.e., not having completed all elective credits of your Degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Be aware of the multidisciplinary context of engineering.
Apply their knowledge and understanding to identify, formulate and solve engineering problems using established methods.
Perform bibliographic searches, use databases and other sources of information.
Select and use appropriate equipment, tools and methods.
Combine theory and practice to solve engineering problems.
Awareness of all implications of engineering practice.
Function effectively both individually and in a team.
Use different methods to communicate effectively with the engineering community and society in general.
Recognize the need and have the ability to voluntarily develop continuous learning.

That students have demonstrated possession and understanding of knowledge in a field of study that builds on general secondary education, and is usually at a level that, while supported by advanced textbooks, also includes aspects involving knowledge from the forefront of their field of study.

That students know how to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences that are usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and problem solving within their area of study.

That students have the ability to gather and interpret relevant data (normally within their area of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific or ethical issues.

syllabus_topics: Tasks to be developed by the student.
Knowledge that the student will acquire.
Whether the student will participate in design, planning or development tasks.
Within which projects or areas the internships will be framed.
Tools that the student will use.
teaching_methods: Mentoring by an academic tutor at Uc3m
assessment_rules: The evaluation system assesses activities performed during company internships, based on a report from the company tutor and a student's report. The academic tutor at Uc3m will grade the student using these documents. Students who do not submit the report will be graded as 'NO PRESENTADO'. If a student abandons the internship before completing the required hours, they will also be graded as 'NO PRESENTADO'.
